rules.title: SQL query built with fmt.Sprintf or concatenation
rules.description: database/sql binds parameters only when you pass them separately. A Sprintf'd query is sent as text.
rules.remediation: Use placeholders and pass the values as trailing arguments: db.Query("SELECT ... WHERE id = $1", id).

rules.title: exec.Command with a shell
rules.description: Going through a shell reintroduces metacharacter parsing that exec.Command otherwise avoids entirely.
rules.remediation: Call the binary directly with its arguments as separate strings.

rules.title: TLS InsecureSkipVerify enabled
rules.description: The client accepts any certificate, so anyone on the path can impersonate the server.
rules.remediation: Leave it false and add the internal CA to RootCAs if needed.

rules.title: math/rand used for a security value
rules.description: math/rand is a deterministic PRNG. An attacker who sees a few outputs can predict the rest.

rules.title: Error from a security-relevant call discarded
rules.description: Assigning the error to _ means a failed verification proceeds exactly like a successful one.
rules.remediation: Check the error and fail closed.

rules.title: File path built from request data
rules.description: filepath.Join cleans the path but does not confine it: a leading ../ still escapes the base directory.
rules.remediation: Join, then check the result still has the base as a prefix - or use http.Dir, which enforces that.

rules.title: Gin left in debug mode
rules.description: Debug mode logs full request details and prints stack traces to clients.
rules.remediation: Call gin.SetMode(gin.ReleaseMode) when not in development.
